newsitem.title: RUSSIA: RUSSIA AVTOBANK SAYS TO ISSUE EUROBOND BY YEAR-END.
newsitem.headline: RUSSIA AVTOBANK SAYS TO ISSUE EUROBOND BY YEAR-END.

text.p: Avtobank, Russia's 10th biggest bank by assets, said on Friday it planned to issue a Eurobond by the end of 1997.
"Currently, we are planning to issue a Eurobond this year," Chairman Natalya Rayevskaya told Reuters.
Rayevskaya said full details of the issue would be announced in six weeks.
Avtobank joins a number of Russian banks planning Eurobonds. Earlier on Friday AB Inkombank said it would issue a total of $500 million of Eurobonds with the first issue to be launched this year.
Alfa-Bank, Uneximbank and SBS-Agro bank have already placed Eurobonds, which are cheaper money than domestic loans.
